# AI Test Workbench (`ai-test-workbench` / `aitw` v6.2.1)

> Trustworthy Verification Kernel & AI-Agent-First native multi-protocol MCP Server (`stdio`, Streamable HTTP `/mcp`, Legacy HTTP+SSE `/sse`) for Playwright E2E/API verification. Supports Chinese-default docs with paired English `.en.md` docs.

## Core v6.2.1 Capabilities
- **Authoritative 4-Layer Anti-Fake-Green Gate Kernel (`src/kernel/gate-kernel.mjs`, `src/kernel/gate/rules/`, `src/governance.mjs`, `src/ledger.mjs`)**: Pluggable `AITEST-G101..G117` semantic AST rules (SymbolTable v2.1 with `let`/destructuring/default-param/loop/status-alias propagation, `AITEST-G116` HTTP status equivalence, `AITEST-G117` Dieselgate guard), fail-closed sticky-T1 `.aitest/governance.lock`, signed `.aitest/baseline-ref` (ignored in CI and on explicit `--base`), `tsc` + `eslint-plugin-playwright` + `static-runner` covering `tests/fixtures/**`, and ULID `Run Ledger` input-hash binding (`FGER-internal = 0.0%`, `FGER-holdout = 0.0%`, `FGER-agentic_T2 = 0.0% (0/18)`, real-world unseen holdout FPR `6.1% (3/49)`).
- **Native Multi-Protocol MCP Server & Job Runner (`src/mcp/`, `src/jobs.mjs`)**: Zero runtime npm dependencies; supports MCP `2024-11-05`..`2025-11-25` with **16 canonical typed tools** (`aitest_bootstrap`, `aitest_heal`, `aitest_job`, and `aitest_report` consolidated, with 8 v5/v6.1 deprecated aliases retained in v6.x), isolated child-process jobs (`syncBudgetMs`) with strict env allowlisting, `_meta.progressToken` heartbeats, `notifications/cancelled` process-tree termination, HTTP Host/Origin/session-cap hardening, and atomic disk locks.
- **One-Call Change Verdict & Stateful Healer (`src/verdict.mjs`, `src/heal.mjs`, `src/traceability.mjs`)**: `aitest_verify_change` emits `attestation.json` (in-toto v1 + T0/T1/T2 with strict X.509 CA/KeyUsage/Fulcio commit-SHA verification), `verdict-summary.md`, and `verdict.sarif.json`; `aitest_heal(action="begin"|"attempt"|"conclude"|"discard")` hard-blocks Class B/C/D test edits (`0.0%` mis-heal rate), supports diff-correlated `A-UI-Sync`, and maps `REQ-xxx` traceability.
- **Zero-to-One Loopback Bootstrap, Import-Graph Impact, Living Code Map & Default-Deny Explorer (`src/bootstrap.mjs`, `src/impact.mjs`, `src/codemap.mjs`, `src/explore.mjs`)**: `aitest_bootstrap` auto-detects loopback servers with runtime config validation; static reverse `import` dependency graph with `why` provenance; default-deny read-only exploration with 10-hop redirect firewall and Redaction v3; preserved `:id`/`[id]` dynamic routes and automatic defect convergence.
- **Template Manifest & Hash-Safe Upgrade (`src/upgrade.mjs`, `src/core/config.mjs`)**: One-way vendor mirror (`templates/playwright-qa/support/`) stamped with SHA-256 digests, idempotent `init`/`upgrade` preserving governance lock hashes, and schema-validated centralized configuration.
- **PerformanceObserver Web Vitals, WCAG 2.0/2.1/2.2 & JSON Schema Contracts (`src/perf.mjs`, `base.ts`, `src/kernel/schema-validator.mjs`)**: Real `LCP / CLS / INP` median & P75 capture, guarded `page.request` + `context.request` + allowlist egress, active W3C `traceparent` correlation, and `100%` seeded-defect detection (`7/7`).
